info.name: NextCraft
info.summary: Open and edit your files in the Craft apps, right inside Nextcloud
info.description:
NextCraft brings the open-source Craft apps (WordCraft, GridCraft, PdfCraft, PhotoCraft, VectorCraft, DesignCraft, CADCraft and more) into Nextcloud.
- **Open with…** any supported file: .docx in WordCraft or Nextcloud Office, .ai in VectorCraft, .indd in DesignCraft, .af in PhotoCraft or VectorCraft, .xlsx in GridCraft… - Each user picks a default app per file type, or is asked each time. - **Save** back to Nextcloud (with versions and conflict detection), **save to** another Nextcloud folder, or **download** to the device. - The apps run in the browser (WebAssembly) on your Nextcloud's own domain: your Nextcloud login is the only login. - Admins install and update the apps from the official releases (checksums verified) with one click or `occ nextcraft:update`.
The Craft apps are developed by storytold (https://github.com/storytold) and are downloaded from their GitHub releases when you install them; NextCraft does not bundle them.
